title: Wick Liquor Banshee 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Wick Liquor Banshee is a mysterious and sparkling fruit blend. It pairs the crisp, sweet notes of Haitian Labadee apple with the floral, aromatic tartness of fizzy Bayou quince. This unique combination offers a complex, effervescent vape that is both refreshing and intriguing. Supplied in a 120ml bottle, this 100ml shortfill leaves space for two 10ml nicotine shots. Adding two 18mg shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. Mixed with a High-VG 70% VG / 30% PG ratio, this e-liquid is optimised for sub-ohm vaping, producing dense clouds and delivering the depth of flavour Wick Liquor is famous for. Wick Liquor is a premium boutique brand from Staffordshire, renowned for their unique "big block" approach to flavour and complex, layered blends.
